children: (“NewGen” or the “Company”), a technology-driven, diversified growth company, today provided an update on its strategic investment in K25.ai and the resulting impact on its indicative net asset value (“NAV”).

NewGen today completed the acquisition of an additional 4% equity interest in PredicXion Group Limited, which operates K25.ai, bringing its cumulative interest to 6%. As previously announced, NewGen has already paid a total deposit of $6,037,500 in shares and cash for the acquisition of the remaining 7% of NewGen’s previously agreed 13% interest in K25.ai. Based on the US$200 million post-money valuation reflected in K25.ai’s Series A financing round, in which Amber Group participated, NewGen expects to measure its 6% interest at approximately US$12 million, reflecting an upward adjustment for an observable price change under U.S. GAAP.

Based on the Company’s book carrying cost of the completed 6% interest of approximately US$4.7 million, NewGen expects to record an unrealized gain of approximately US$7.3 million related to this investment for the year ending December 31, 2026. This non-cash gain is expected to strengthen the Company’s balance sheet and reflects the increase in K25.ai’s valuation since NewGen’s initial investment.
Net Asset Value and Indicative Adjusted Net Asset Value

As of June 30, 2026, the Company’s net asset value, which the Company defines as total equity as reported in its unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheet, was US$25,713,362. Adjusted solely for the expected unrealized gain of approximately US$7.3 million on the K25.ai investment, the Company’s indicative adjusted net assets would be approximately US$33.0 million. Indicative adjusted NAV is a non-GAAP measure. It does not reflect the Company's operating results, financing activities or other developments since June 30, 2026, and is not a substitute for the Company's financial statements prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP. NAV is not intended to represent the fair value of the Company’s assets or the value of its shares.

“The completion of our cumulative 6% stake in K25.ai, with an implied value of $12 million based on an observable price and with an expected unrealized gain of approximately $7.3 million based on our book carrying cost, meaningfully enhances the Company’s asset base,” said Alfred Siu, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of NewGen. “Starting from our June 30 NAV of approximately $25.7 million and incorporating this subsequent event, our indicative adjusted NAV of approximately $33 million reflects the strategic progress we have made and strengthens our foundation for continued growth.”

NewGenIVF Group Limited is a technology-forward, diversified growth company pursuing opportunities across real estate development, digital asset innovation, and reproductive health solutions. The Company operates through NewGenProperty, focused on real estate development projects in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates; NewGenDigital, focused on digital asset and decentralized-finance solutions; and NewGenSup, focused on health and longevity products and solutions. NewGenIVF’s legacy business includes IVF and assisted reproductive treatment services across Asia. To learn more, visit www.nivf.global. Information contained on, or accessible through, the Company’s website is not incorporated by reference into this press release.
